# The Assur Caravan — website 2.3.1

Browser game. No installation required. See the repository README for editing, tests, research notes and GitHub Pages setup.

Edit `about.html` for the introduction, credits and contact information; `rules.js` for numerical rules; `guide.js` for player instructions.

Iron is offered at most twice per season, with no guarantee of an offer. Each offer counts immediately, even if declined. Declining or leaving the crossing ends that offer permanently. Textiles have the higher typical return. Version 2.3.0 saves upgrade automatically using the journal of earlier offers; other older versions require a new game.
